habitat: Tropical lowland rainforest; primary lowland forests; and plantations below 500 m
story: In the diverse world of birds, the Sabah Partridge (Tropicoperdix graydoni) stands out. This species, part of the Phasianidae family, is a resident of Tropical lowland rainforest; primary lowland forests; and plantations below 500 m. Its IUCN Red List status is Near Threatened (NT), which serves as a call to action for habitat preservation. The Sabah Partridge is more than just a bird; it is a symbol of the rich biodiversity that we must protect. Through this poster, we hope to foster a greater understanding and appreciation for the Sabah Partridge and its role in the ecosystem.
Every poster is crafted to inspire curiosity about our planet's incredible biodiversity.
